facts.claim: Cost per install in India runs about 0.12 times the United States level, 70% to 90% lower
facts.source_title: Cost per install benchmarks by country, platform and category
facts.excerpt: India has a CPI of 0.12x relative to the United States. CPIs in India are often 70-90% lower than US CPIs.

facts.claim: India's median cost per install fell from 0.71 dollars in July 2025 to 0.42 dollars in June 2026
facts.source_title: Cost per install benchmarks by country, platform and category
facts.excerpt: India's median CPI averaged about $1.18 per install, starting at $0.71 in July 2025 and finishing at $0.42 in June 2026.

facts.claim: United States fintech cost per install is 11.62 dollars on iOS and 3.84 on Android, against 2.46 and 0.84 for utilities
facts.source_title: Cost per install benchmarks by country, platform and category
facts.excerpt: US CPIs by category include Fintech ($11.62 iOS / $3.84 Android) and Utilities ($2.46 / $0.84).

facts.claim: Subscription apps typically recover acquisition cost in 60 to 90 days
facts.excerpt: For subscription apps the typical CAC payback period is 60-90 days, depending on plan length, trial conversion rate and pricing.

facts.claim: Median LTV:CAC is 2.5 to 1 for apps priced 8.99 to 11.99 a month and 2.7 to 1 at 12.99 to 14.99
facts.excerpt: Apps pricing at $8.99-$11.99 monthly have a median LTV:CAC of 2.5:1; $12.99-$14.99 achieve 2.7:1.

facts.claim: India and South-East Asia show the lowest regional median trial-to-paid conversion at 15.2%, against 34.2% in North America
facts.excerpt: North America median 34.2%, Asia-Pacific 31.9%, Western Europe 29.7%, IN/SEA lowest at 15.2%
